summary: Confirmed fees 47-57, electric 50, water, military; added sewer false, season 05-22..10-12, holiday minimums, booking, dump, store. Note cleaned.
flags: GATE: $47 posted for 2026 for the cheapest 20/30A site; holiday $51 and Fly-In $53 are event pricing. RV Life 2026 paid $45-65 (the higher on 50A). Under $50 off-peak. Gateway: none within 40 km. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false).
PHONE: entry has none. Operator and Google: (207) 695-2210.
RATINGS: Google 4.4 (166); RV Life 4.5 (44); The Dyrt 4.14 (count not read); Campendium 3.8 (5), too few to drop; Campspot not listed. None under 4.0 with 25+.

FACILITIES: RV Life reviews say the toilets are vault ('bathroom vault toilets', 'pit toilets') with nice showers; operator's text says only bathhouse/rest rooms, so I wrote neither toilets nor showers.

Per-site rig notes live in the site map's popups, not read; stored max_rig_ft 45 left. WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands ('one mile south of Moosehead Lake'). Pin ~150 m W of the site centre (on Route 15), under the move threshold.
